tree.splitter: sklearn KMeans(n_clusters=2, n_init=10, random_state=42) per node
tree.child_rule: children of level-d id p are 2p (bit 0), 2p+1 (bit 1); bit-0 child has smaller first centroid coordinate

stopping.rule: real E_l > null p95 AND q_bh < 0.05, coarse->fine, stop at first failure

label_free: hierarchy, energies, null, stopping and depth are derived from train signals/latents only
